terms.comment: An ancient rope noun; a generic noun, also usable for a climbing rope.

phrases.english: Here are the rope and knot.

sources: Lewis & Short: funis

These are names and conversational prompts, not instructions for fitting a harness, tying a knot or operating a belay. Examples are composed for conversation with the child; dictionary links document the component words, not these exact sentences or standardized modern climbing terminology.
The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 48.
